verdict.rationale: 1Password ships an official CLI (`op`). It has first-party get-started and reference docs, including commands like `op item list`, and is packaged in Homebrew as the 1password-cli cask (v2.39.0). It is described as the scriptable surface behind service accounts, Connect, and secrets automation, and its docs have LLM-readable .md mirrors. missing for 10: independent community or hands-on corroboration of CLI use in agent workflows, documentation of agent-oriented CLI features such as machine-readable output.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: the official op CLI is packaged in Homebrew as the 1password-cli cask ('Command-line interface for 1Password', v2.39.0) — the scriptable surface behind service accounts, Connect, and secrets automation.
https://www.1password.dev/cli/get-started.md returns markdown '# Get started with 1Password CLI'
